_comment: Production configuration for FishMMO Discord Bot. Overrides Development defaults. The bot token and database connection string MUST be set via environment variables (Discord__Token, ConnectionStrings__Npgsql). Do not commit real credentials here.

Discord._comment_token: Token MUST be set via environment variable Discord__Token at runtime. An empty token causes the bot to fail at startup. Never commit the token to source control.
Discord._comment_guild_id: 0 means disabled. Set to a real Discord guild ID (snowflake) for the bot to operate in a specific server.
